title: Seeing Seeds Beyond Weeds: Green Teaming Generative AI for Beneficial Uses

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of ChatGPT's content moderation filters when prompted to simulate a suicidal patient, demonstrating how safety guardrails implicitly stigmatize discussions of suicidality and preclude beneficial experiential training tools.

Comparative policy analysis of generative image models (DALL-E 2 vs. Midjourney) evaluating how ostensibly 'neutral' anti-harassment policies prohibit the mockery of public figures, thereby disproportionately restricting LGBTQ+ activists from generating political satire such as depicting anti-LGBTQ+ politicians in drag.

Critique and analysis of image generation content policies to show how enforcing neutrality and universally protecting political figures from caricature inherently sides with powerful political figures over marginalized groups.
